title: Scotland Non-domestic Energy Performance Certificates - Dataset to Q2 2026: row
description: One row of the Scottish Government CSV for 'Non-domestic Energy Performance Certificates - Dataset to Q2 2026' (https://www.data.gov.scot/dataset/non_domestic_energy_performance_certificates___dataset_to_q1_2026), as an object of raw string values keyed by the column names in row 1 of the CSV. Row 2 holds descriptive labels, given here as property titles.

missing.description: Empty value or the source's missing-value marker.

BUILDING_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: Property_UPRN
BUILDING_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique 10-digit identifier for the property, generated by the SEPCR to enable the EPC lodgement process even where there is no current matching UPRN for the assessed property extents (building or building unit). Not the same as the Unique Property Reference Number available from the One Scotland Gazetteer.

OSG_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: OSG_UPRN
OSG_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique 9-12-digit property reference number assigned to a building by local authority data custodians and recorded centrally on the One Scotland Gazetteer - OSG | One Scotland Gazetteer.

ADDRESS1.title: Address1
ADDRESS1.description: First line of the building address

ADDRESS2.title: Address2
ADDRESS2.description: Second line of the building address

POST_TOWN.title: Post Town
POST_TOWN.description: Third line of the building address. Note that ADDRESS3 is assigned as POST_TOWN

INSPECTION_DATE.title: Date of Assessment
INSPECTION_DATE.description: Date on which the energy performance of the building was undertaken

LODGEMENT_DATE.title: Date of Certificate
LODGEMENT_DATE.description: Date on which the energy performance assessment was lodged to the Scottish EPC Register

FLOOR_AREA.title: Total floor area (m2)
FLOOR_AREA.description: Total area of the assessed building (referring to the area of the building that is conditioned (heated or cooled) by energy. (Units: m2)

CURRENT_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.title: Current Energy Performance Rating
CURRENT_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.description: Building Energy Performance Rating for the actual building, reported as the calculated emissions for the building. (Units: kg of CO2 per m2 per year).

CURRENT_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.title: Energy Band
CURRENT_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.description: Reports 'Current Energy Performance Rating' on a scale of A+ to G with A+ (0 or lower) being best and G (100+) being worst.

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.title: Potential Energy Performance Rating
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.description: Building Energy Performance Rating for the building if identified improvements are carried out, reported as the calculated emissions for the building. (Units: kg of CO2 per m2 per year).

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.title: Potential Band
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.description: Reports 'Potential Energy Performance Rating' on a scale of A+ to G with A+ (0 or lower) being best and G (100+) being worst.

NEW_BUILD_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.title: New Build Benchmark Rating
NEW_BUILD_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_RATING.description: The Energy Performance Rating for the building if constructed to meet the building regulations current at the date of assessment, reported as the calculated emissions for the building. (Units: kg of CO2 per m2 per year).

NEW_BUILD_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.title: New Build Benchmark Band
NEW_BUILD_ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BAND.description: Reports the New Build Benchmark Rating on a scale of A+ to G with A+ (0 or lower) being best and G (100+) being worst.

MEETS_2002_STANDARD.title: Compliant 2002
MEETS_2002_STANDARD.description: Reports whether the building would meet the energy standards applicable to a building constructed to the 2002 energy standards. Use to demonstrate one exemption under The Energy Assessment of Non-domestic Buildings (Scotland) Regulations 2016 (see: Improving the building stock - Building standards - gov.scot (www.gov.scot)). Note: this data element is not reported in records lodged prior to 20 March 2016.

ASSET_RATING.title: Comparative Asset Rating
ASSET_RATING.description: Reports on the asset rating of the building if assessed using Scottish weather data and the additional ratings methodology applied for the production of EPCs in England & Wales. Note: introduced to provide a reporting measure for the UK Government Feed-in Tariff.

ASSET_RATING_BAND.title: Comparative Energy Band
ASSET_RATING_BAND.description: Reports the Comparative Asset Rating on a scale of A+ to G with A+ (0 or lower) being best and G (100+) being worst. Note: introduced to provide a reporting measure for the UK Government Feed-in Tariff.

BUILDING_EMISSIONS.title: EPC Rating BER
BUILDING_EMISSIONS.description: 'Building Emission Rate.' The calculated emissions for the building, presented as a whole number in 'Current Energy Performance Rating.' (Units: kg of CO2 per m2 per year).

RENEWABLE_SOURCES.title: Renewable Energy Source
RENEWABLE_SOURCES.description: Recorded where a low or zero carbon technology (equipment that either generates or otherwise provides energy with no or little resulting emissions) is present in the building. Examples include photovoltaic panels, heat pumps and wind turbines. Note: 'other, non-calculated' indicates a renewable energy source but benefit that cannot be calculated within SBEM.

ELECTRICITY_SOURCE.title: Electricity_Source
ELECTRICITY_SOURCE.description: Identifies whether electricity supplied to the building is from the national grid or from another source.

MAIN_HEATING_FUEL.title: Main Heating Fuel
MAIN_HEATING_FUEL.description: Reports the fuel type used by the main heating system present in the building.

BUILDING_ENVIRONMENT.title: Building Environment
BUILDING_ENVIRONMENT.description: Reports on the type and extent of ventilation system used within the building.

PRIMARY_ENERGY_VALUE.title: Actual Building Data Primary Energy Indicator
PRIMARY_ENERGY_VALUE.description: The amount of energy required at source, before conversion, to meet the calculated energy demand of the existing building (Units: kWh/m2/year). Note: calculated by applying primary energy factors to the total energy use for each fuel used in the building.

APPROXIMATE_ENERGY_USE.title: Actual Building Data Approx Energy Use
APPROXIMATE_ENERGY_USE.description: The calculated total energy use for the building (energy demand minus energy generated on site). (Units: kWh/m2/year). Note: used, together with carbon factors for fuels to calculate the building emissions ('Current Energy Performance Rating' and 'BER').

IMPROVEMENT_RECOMMENDATIONS.title: Recommendations
IMPROVEMENT_RECOMMENDATIONS.description: A list of the improvement measures identified as relevant to the building at the date of assessment. These measures are either standard measures drawn from Annex B5.0 of the SBEM Technical Manual or are created by the EPC Assessor. Improvement measures are listed sequentially under a single data entry in the following format: 'Measure code; CO2 impact; Payback Type; Description.' Each measure is separated by a vertical line [ "|" - ASCII (decimal) 124]

LOCAL_AUTHORITY.title: Local Authority Identifier
LOCAL_AUTHORITY.description: The code of the local authority area in which the building is located.

DATA_ZONE.title: Data Zone
DATA_ZONE.description: Data Zone code and name - Data zones are the key geography for the dissemination of small area statistics in Scotland.

CONSTITUENCY.title: Ward Code
CONSTITUENCY.description: Code for Parliamentary constituency in which the building is located. Scottish area defined as 'Ward', not 'constituency'

CONSTITUENCY_LABEL.title: Ward Name
CONSTITUENCY_LABEL.description: Name of Parliamentary constituency in which the building is located. Scottish area defined as 'Ward', not 'constituency'

TRANSACTION_TYPE.title: Transaction Type
TRANSACTION_TYPE.description: Purpose for which assessment was carried out, as declared by building owner/commissioning party. - Mandatory issue (Marketed sale) - Mandatory issue (Non-marketed sale) - Mandatory issue (Property on construction) - Mandatory issue (Property to let) - Mandatory issue (Display in public building) (option added in 2016) - Voluntary (No legal requirement for an EPC) - Voluntary re-issue (A valid EPC is already lodged)

TARGET_EMISSIONS.title: EPC Rating TER
TARGET_EMISSIONS.description: 'Target Emission Rate.' The calculated emissions for the same building, if newly constructed to the building regulations applicable at the date of assessment. (Units: kg of CO2 per m2 per year).

DATA_ZONE_2011.title: Data Zone 2011
DATA_ZONE_2011.description: Data zones from 2011, representing small areas across Scotland of around 500 - 1,000 household residents.

CREATED_AT.title: Lodgement Date
CREATED_AT.description: The date and time that the certificate was lodged on the register.

REPORT_REFERENCE_NUMBER.title: RRN
REPORT_REFERENCE_NUMBER.description: Unique, auto-generated number produced on the lodgement of and EPC to the SEPCR.
